title: Validate negative Reorder Quantity for Fixed Reorder Qty. planning
summary: Item, Item Template, and Stockkeeping Unit now reject negative Reorder Quantities with a clear validation error, and planning failures for Fixed Reorder Qty. policy are replaced with actionable error messages.
key_points: Reorder Quantity on Item, Item Templ. and Stockkeeping Unit now has MinValue = 0; Item and Item Templ. changes are propagated to country layers
CalcReorderQty in Inventory Profile Offsetting raises a clear field error for negative values under Fixed Reorder Qty. instead of the internal 'Inventory Profile does not exist' error
With planning resiliency, the error is written to the Planning Error Log with the actual value instead of a hard-coded 0
Existing negative values are not migrated; zero quantities behave as before
New SCM planning test covers the negative quantity error
